title: Rollin' Search
css: .d-drams-043{width:100%;height:320px;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;background:#fff;color:#555;font:400 12px "Inter",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}.d-drams-043 *{box-sizing:border-box}.d-drams-043 button,.d-drams-043 input{font:inherit}.d-drams-043 [role=slider],.d-drams-043 button{touch-action:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}.d-drams-043 :is(button,input,[role=slider]):focus-visible{outline:2px solid #bd5b2a;outline-offset:7px}.d-drams-043 .sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.d-drams-043 *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}.d-drams-043 .search-shell{position:relative;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:24px;background:#f3f3f3;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #00000005;transition:width .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.d-drams-043 .search-shell[data-open=true]{width:180px}.d-drams-043 .search-shell input{width:calc(100% - 43px);height:44px;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:#5d5d5d;outline:0;font:400 13px "Inter",sans-serif;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s .1s}.d-drams-043 .search-shell[data-open=true] input{padding:0 0 0 17px;opacity:1}.d-drams-043 .search-shell input::-webkit-search-cancel-button{display:none}.d-drams-043 .search-shell button{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff914f,#fa742b 50%,#e6601d);box-shadow:inset 1px 1px 2px #ffb67a,1px 2px 3px #00000012,5px 10px 15px #00000015;cursor:pointer}.d-drams-043 .search-shell svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.d-drams-043 .search-shell[data-open=true] svg{transform:rotate(360deg)}
prompt: Build a self-contained, accessible native HTML/CSS/JavaScript interpretation of Rollin' Search from https://drams.framer.website/drams/043. Credit DRAMS by 1042 Studio (@mrblackstudio and @karimeshrimp). A small orange search orb rolls to the right as a pale search field expands from it. Type a query and press Enter; Escape folds it away. Use a white 320px stage, soft neutral contact shadows, subtle physical edge highlights and orange details. click to open, enter a query, and press Escape to close. Preserve pointer and keyboard operation, reduced-motion support and the distinct geometry of this component. No hosted Framer embed or external runtime dependency.
